profiles.meeting_scenario: The legal coordination meeting concerns the 2025 summer-season beach management package for the municipality of Calafell on the Catalan coast, where the municipality wants to incorporate elements of the Beach Quality Index into its seasonal beach management plan and align that plan with coastal occupation authorizations, service concessions, and waste-control obligations. The agenda is to coordinate interfaces between the municipal legal office and external coastal-regulation counsel: which legal annexes are being drafted, what belongs in the submission package to the provincial coastal authority, which expediente they are working inside, and when the next draft is ready for circulation. The expected outcome is apparent agreement on handoffs and timing for a 'consolidated draft,' the contents of the legal annex, and the next filing step, even though subtle assumptions remain misaligned.

members.name: Marta Soler
members.role: Head of Municipal Legal Services, Ajuntament de Calafell
members.expertise: Local administrative law, municipal procedure, public-domain occupation permits, coordination with the town secretary and elected officials
members.background: Marta trained in Spanish public law and spent eight years in a town secretary's office before moving into municipal legal management for coastal-service dossiers.
members.private_state: She wants the municipality's beach plan to survive procedural scrutiny and avoid any appearance that the town is assuming obligations outside its formal competence or circulating unfinished legal text to outside actors too early.
hidden_assumptions: A 'consolidated draft' is a clean, near-final version suitable for internal sign-off by the secretary, not a collaborative working file with comments still visible.
When colleagues say 'the file' or 'the expediente,' they mean the 2025 seasonal occupation dossier opened in January for the municipality's urban beaches.

The 'submission package' to Costas should contain only documents the municipality formally owns or certifies, while concessionaire operating materials stay outside the main filing unless specifically requested.
An annex to the beach management plan naturally stops at matters within municipal competence, such as public-use rules, cleaning schedules, signage, and enforcement references.

members.name: Diego Ferrer
members.role: External Environmental and Coastal Counsel for the municipality's beach-management support team
members.expertise: Coastal law, environmental compliance, drafting permit-support documentation, translating operational management indicators into defensible legal and regulatory language
members.background: Diego previously worked in a regional environmental agency and now advises coastal municipalities on integrating management tools, concession obligations, and compliance evidence into seasonal authorizations.
members.private_state: He wants the Beach Quality Index elements embedded this season without reopening high-level political debate, and he is trying to keep momentum by reusing existing dossier structures and incorporating material from operational contractors.
hidden_assumptions: A 'consolidated draft' is the master working version that gathers everyone's tracked edits and comments in one place before a clean version is produced later.
When people refer to 'the file' or 'the expediente,' they mean the umbrella beach-management dossier that was carried forward after the 2024 inspection issues and can absorb this year's materials.

The 'submission package' is stronger if it includes operator protocols, litter-monitoring sheets, and concession-related commitments, because the authority cares about actual beach management performance, not only formal municipal resolutions.

An annex to the beach management plan naturally includes linked obligations of concessionaires and waste contractors when those obligations support compliance with coastal and environmental conditions.

misalignment_points.surface_form: Both agree that Diego will send a 'consolidated draft' before the next internal review.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Marta understands this as a clean, internally presentable version with integrated edits and no visible markup, suitable for the secretary and councillor to read as a near-final text.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Diego understands this as the single working master file combining tracked changes and comments from legal, concessions, waste, and environmental contributors.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: In legal coordination, 'consolidated draft' sounds routine and shared; both assume the other uses standard document terminology from their own workflow, so neither feels a need to define the file state explicitly.

misalignment_points.surface_form: Both speak about putting material 'into the file' and checking what is already 'in the expediente.'
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Marta is thinking of the 2025 seasonal coastal occupation expediente opened in January for this year's municipal beach-service authorizations.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Diego is thinking of the broader umbrella dossier continued from the 2024 inspection and compliance cycle, which he treats as the operative folder for all related beach-management materials.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: Both dossiers concern the same beaches, same municipality, and overlapping compliance issues, so references to 'the file' sound perfectly natural and do not trigger clarification unless someone names the expediente number.

misalignment_points.topic: What belongs in the 'submission package' / annex
misalignment_points.surface_form: Both agree to finalize the 'submission package' and the legal annex for the beach management plan.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Marta assumes the package includes the municipal resolution, competence-based annexes, maps, service descriptions, and legal references, but excludes concessionaire protocols and contractor monitoring materials unless separately appended later.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Diego assumes the package includes not only municipal documents but also concession protocols, Beach Quality Index monitoring sheets, and waste-management commitments because they substantiate practical compliance.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: At the surface level, both are discussing the same package for the same authority and using ordinary filing language; the boundary question feels too secondary and obvious to either of them to spell out during a routine coordination call.

turns.inner_thought: I need this 2025 seasonal occupation dossier kept procedurally tidy. The annex has to stay within municipal competence, and the package for Costas must be limited to what the municipality can properly own and certify. If we keep the legal framing narrow, the secretary can sign off without worrying that we've imported third-party operating commitments into our filing.
